title: Devfactory Provider Config
description: Schema for Provider.Config when Provider.Type is "devfactory". Devfactory is a reference/simulation provider — no real infrastructure required — used for end-to-end testing and as a template for provider authors.

data_dir.description: Directory where devfactory.json is stored. If empty, a temporary directory is created automatically.

profile.description: What kind of resource this provider simulates. Default: "container".

latency.description: Simulated provisioning delay before a resource transitions from creating to running. Zero/omitted uses the profile default. Accepts a human-readable duration string (e.g. "800ms", "1.5s") or a number of nanoseconds.

exec_output_chunks.description: Deterministic stdout chunks emitted by UpdateStream for an exec operation. Empty/omitted uses one simulated output chunk.

exec_chunk_delay.description: Delay between configured exec_output_chunks. Accepts a human-readable duration string or nanoseconds.

fail_create.description: If true, Create returns an error. Useful for testing error handling paths.

fail_update.description: If true, Update returns an error.

fail_delete.description: If true, Delete returns an error.

fail_list.description: If true, resource listing returns an error to simulate an unverifiable provider inventory. Useful for exercising fail-closed reconciliation without real Hyper-V infrastructure.

fail_create_as.description: If set, Create fails with a specific typed provider error instead of a plain one, letting a consumer exercise typed-error handling against this reference driver. fail_create (a plain error) takes precedence if both are set. "capacity" returns a CapacityError, defaulting to a self-consistent insufficient-capacity scenario unless available_memory_zero or a low available_memory_mb is also configured. "orphaned_resource" returns an OrphanedResourceError and leaves the resource's record behind in "creating" state, discoverable via the driver's resource listing and removable with a later delete.

labels.description: Labels passed through to resource metadata.

available_memory_mb.description: Value Availability() reports as available memory, in megabytes. Zero (the default) means unlimited.

available_memory_zero.description: If true, Availability() reports exactly zero MB available, overriding available_memory_mb (whose own zero value means "unlimited" and so can't itself express insufficient capacity).
